<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/showcase.ts -->
<!--
  A picture that stays in view while the feature descriptions scroll beside it. `active` marks the description
  that is current (the page follows the scroll; that is a port contract). Axes: mediaSide (end, start), item
  (plain, card), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type FeatureStickyProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    features: Feature[];
    active?: string;
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    item?: "plain" | "card";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    features,
    active = "",
    mediaSide = "end",
    item = "plain",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: FeatureStickyProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density}>
  <Grid cols="1-2" class="items-start gap-8" data-testid="sticky">
    <Box
      class={cn(
        "md:sticky md:top-8",
        (((mediaSide as string) === "start") ? "md:order-first" : "md:order-last")
      )}
      data-testid="sticky-media"
    >
      <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
    </Box>
    <Stack gap={(((density as string) === "compact") ? "4" : "8")} align="stretch" data-testid="items">
      {#each features as f (f.id)}
        <Stack
          gap="2"
          class={cn(
            (((item as string) === "card") ? "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6" : "py-4"),
            ((f.id === active) ? "inset-ring inset-ring-foreground" : "")
          )}
          data-testid="item"
          aria-current={((f.id === active) ? "true" : undefined)}
        >
          <LucideIcon name={f.icon} size={24} />
          <Title as={3} size="2xl" weight="bold">
            {f.title}
          </Title>
          <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {f.text}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
